articles.title: Rainbow Six Siege Dev On Competing With GTA 6 And Why There Are No Plans For Siege 2
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 releases this November, and it's expected to take up a lot of time and attention, leading some to worry how other games may fare in its wake.
body: "All of us are going to play it," Mills told The Game Business.

So what can Ubisoft do for Siege when GTA 6 comes out? He said, "It's about being smart and with your expectations so you can keep the team and HQ aligned." He said if the developers working on Siege see the game's player numbers drop, "they can get anxious." However, he observed that the effect on player numbers from a big competitor release is "generally temporary."
Whatever the case, Mills said the "golden rule" that Ubisoft operates by is by serving "the players who stay like kings and queens."
"We don’t go on vacation just because a competitor is swelling the market. We double down and reward those spending their valuable time with us," he said.

articles.title: 30 Years Later, Collecting Pokemon Cards Hits A Little Different
articles.summary: Let me sound like an old for a second. I remember in the late '90s and early '00s, collecting Pokemon cards was a casual hobby. You'd go to your local brick-and-mortar store with the money you made from mowing the lawn or whatever, drop maybe $10 on a couple of packs, rip them open, then go to your…
body: It was so low-key back in the day. Saying that grosses me out, as I sound like a Boomer or Gen Xer, but it's true: Collecting Pokemon cards wasn't that serious, and we didn't put much stock in the cards, stuffing them in bags or pockets and watching them turn up in washing machines.

There have been plenty of incidents involving card collecting and violence lately. Robbers stole over $100,000 in rare cards from a California store in December 2025. A different set of robbers made off with nearly $120,000 in rare cards at gunpoint in New York in January 2026. Police broke up a chaotic Costco scene over Prismatic Evolutions in April 2026. And more recently, a Connecticut man was arrested for assaulting someone in a Target after being confronted for exceeding the store's limit for Pokemon card packs, while a 72-year-old Ohio man pleaded guilty to using a GPS tracker to stalk a woman stocking Pokemon cards.

articles.title: Crocodile Dundee Is Getting a 4K Steelbook Edition for Its 40th Anniversary
articles.summary: Crocodile Dundee, the 1986 box office hit, is getting the 4K steelbook treatment. The movie will be available December 1 for $39.99, but it’s available now for preorder at Amazon. I, for one, am excited.
body: It may be hard to imagine now, in an era when theatrical releases for comedies are few and far between, but there was a period during the 1980s when Crocodile Dundee was king. The character, played by Paul Hogan, was a pop culture icon. That’s because this movie was a mega-hit.

Made for under $10 million, Crocodile Dundee grossed $328 million worldwide, landing it at number two on the list of highest-grossing movies of 1986, behind only Top Gun. That’s a remarkable feat for a movie about an Outback outdoorsman.

Crocodile Dundee works because it’s a mix of tried-and-true ideas: It’s a fish-out-of-water story and a romance between an unlikely couple. It starts when Sue Charlton (Linda Kozlowski), a New York journalist, travels to the Australian Outback and meets the titular hero, a hunter who feels more at home in the wilderness than he does around other people.

Soon Sue invites Croc to come back to NYC with her. He agrees, and plenty of comedic hijinks ensue as Dundee’s outdoorsy sensibilities clash with city living. Cue Sue’s gradual romantic feelings toward Dundee, and her ambivalence about her current boyfriend.
points: Crocodile Dundee, the 1986 box office hit, is getting the 4K steelbook treatment.

articles.title: High On Life Is Helping Make The Case For Bigger Games On Quest
articles.summary: High on Life has been a big hit since it first launched in 2022, thanks to its bizarre sense of humor, motor-mouthed guns, and polished gameplay. But can it succeed as a virtual reality port?
body: While it's still early days for the project, I took the time to chat to High on Life VR game director Emily O'Neal and Eric Masher, co-founder and chief operating officer for Impact Reality and Flat2VR Studios, about this project and the challenges involved in adapting it for a new platform.

"We want to bring them those high-quality games like High on Life, that [have] more teeth, more depth, and more playability as an actual game. We're not here just for a short snapshot in time; we're here to help grow this industry to where it will be in three to five years from now. Our job and our mission at Flat2VR is to bring the immersive, amazing games that you love playing right now on your console and PC, but bring it to another platform that makes a whole bunch of sense and that feels completely different but still the same.”

Bringing High on Life to VR isn't an easy task either, as you can't just press a "Convert to VR" button for a project of this scale. As O'Neal explained, the original game is massive, and the team is looking to make it run as smoothly as possible on a VR headset.

articles.title: Tolkien's Silmarillion Illustrated Edition Drops to Its Lowest Price Ever for Amazon Prime Members
articles.summary: If you're a Tolkien fan, you likely know that there's always more lore to discover. That's where the Silmarillion comes in. Unlike the other Lord of the Rings books that focus on narrative storytelling, the Silmarillion is a deep dive into the mythology and history that defines Middle Earth.
body: The Silmarillion is available in multiple versions, but the illustrated editions offer the best overall experience thanks to maps, drawings, and more from Tolkien himself. If you're interested in learning more about Middle Earth straight from the source, Amazon is currently discounting the collector's edition to its lowest price ever ahead of Prime Big Deal Days.

If you're not already familiar with what the Silmarillion actually is, here's a quick rundown: This book covers the early history of its fictional universe, Eä, and the various lands it contains. This includes Valinor, Beleriand, Númenor, and, of course, Middle-Earth. Broken up into five distinct parts, readers can expect deep lore exposition, extensive historical accounts of the First Age, and summaries of the Third Age stories we know and love, the Lord of the Rings.

The illustrated edition itself is 432 pages long and includes the complete text of the Silmarillion alongside full-color prints of Tolkien's illustrations. It also includes two removable fold-out maps. It's essentially a deep dive into the inner workings of one of the best-selling fantasy franchises of all time.

The experience was so popular that the GTA 6 booth closed after just 10 minutes, having already reached capacity — but savvy fans saw an opportunity to capitalize on the overwhelming demand and make some quick cash.

As spotted by Dexerto, the commemorative T-shirts handed out by PlayStation at the game's TGS 2026 booth for free have already made their way online and are being resold on platforms like eBay for hundreds of dollars.

A quick browse on eBay shows a handful of listings pricing the shirts around $140 - $200, while other goodies that were given out at Rockstar’s booth, like GTA 6-branded stickers and carabiners, are being marked up to the tune of $30 - $40.

articles.title: Arc Raiders’ Battle Pass Won’t Be Totally Free Anymore, But It’ll Pay For Itself
articles.summary: When Arc Raiders' next major update, Frozen Trail, goes live on October 8, it'll introduce lots of changes and additions, and while the update itself will be free, the new battle pass system that comes with it won't be--at least not entirely.
body: To date, Arc Raiders has featured three battle pass-like Raider Decks in the game. Players could complete dailies to unlock Creds that then got them rewards like new cosmetics and in-game items. With Frozen Trail, Embark Studios' new Reward Pass is replacing this system with one quite like it, only it'll also have a paid premium track for unlocking additional rewards.

Anyone who owns the game gets the Free Pass, naturally, while the paid track will cost 1,150 Raider Tokens, or about $10 USD. Thankfully, Embark is taking the opportunity to sort the rewards responsibly, with the Premium Pass offering only cosmetic items. Players will get gameplay-altering items, like new weapons and gear, exclusively through the Free Pass. This approach avoids any type of pay-to-win debacle.

articles.title: Discord launches controversial age-verification system "using the most privacy-preserving approach we could build" months after first delay
articles.summary: Discord delayed the rollout of its controversial age verification system back in February after very loud backlash against the company's plans. Those age checks are now back, but this time, co-founder and chief technology officer Stanislav Vishnevskiy says the updated system will give users options…
body: Near the start of the year, Discord's age checks planned to automatically give all users a "teen-appropriate experience" by blurring potentially "sensitive content" or restricting access to age-gated channels. Getting rid of the blocks would have required users to verify their age by submitting a photo of their government-issued ID or a video recording of their face to one of the platform's third-party vendors. As you can imagine, Discord users weren't thrilled about sharing sensitive data like that.

"Age assurance draws strong opinions and scepticism, especially when it involves sharing biometric information or a form of ID," Vishnevskiy said in a new blog post. "At the same time, age assurance laws are expanding, and since my last post we've had to launch age assurance in other regions, including in Brazil and in Texas. We're hearing from policymakers in countless states and countries who want stronger teen protections, from the European Union to Indonesia. To me, that makes it more important than ever to show that this can be done in a privacy-preserving way: one where more than 90% of you won’t have to confirm your age."

articles.title: Discord's Controversial Age Verification Policy Starts Today
articles.summary: In February, Discord announced "teen-by-default" settings and a controversial age-verification policy to change those settings. Backlash was swift, and users immediately tried to find alternative chat services.
body: In a new blog post titled "Safer for Teens, Same Discord for Adults," Discord CTO and co-founder Stanislav Vishnevskiy outlined how the policies work, stressing multiple times that 90% of users won't be asked to confirm their ages. Discord is automatically placing users into various age groups "using account signals, like how long your account has existed and the kinds of servers you're part of. We use multiple account signals to determine age groups at an accuracy level matching what’s possible with biometrics. No single server determines your age group, and we don't look at your messages, calls, or other content to decide which age group you’re in."

You can check your group by looking at the " Account Status " page in your user settings. As Vishnevskiy notes, the new settings will be launched throughout this week, so you may not see anything new in your settings right away.

Depending on what age group Discord has sorted you into, the way you interact with the app might change. Nothing will change for adults, while teens will have some content restricted. Users in the "unconfirmed" group will also face restrictions on adult content until they confirm their age.

articles.title: Where to find pepper leaves in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
articles.summary: In Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, you can collect pepper leaves from some nodes far from Dagsion. While there's a chance of one of these leaves could come in a crate, the best approach when you want to guarantee that you will have the material is to go to the world map, visit the right nodes and use…
body: Below, learn the location of all the nodes where you can find pepper leaves in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave.

Unlike wonder leaves, which are pretty rare, you can find pepper leaves in multiple nodes. There are no significant differences between the nodes, so you can choose to travel to the ones that would be more useful to visit, whether because of proximity or secondary objectives you have.

One of the nodes you reach quickly and obtain pepper leaves is the Myugria Great Tree in Saveilon. This area is on the south part of the map, and you can get to this specific node by traveling to the Salacia Posthouse, and then heading south.

The second place where you can travel to without too much trouble is in the Traveler's Garden node. To get there, you will need to head northeast to the Castalia region. By using a carriage to Eochaid Posthouse, you will find yourself fairly close to the node. Just keep moving east of the Port of Pandora, then move north once you reach Zethus Falls.

articles.title: As Halo goes to Activision, fans are worried about this year's Halo Fest and a potential lore reboot from the Call of Duty publisher
articles.summary: We're now living in a timeline that would have been impossible to comprehend for a grunt-squashing teen in 2007: Activision is making the next Halo game. And, now, fans have questions about the change. Is this year's Halo Fest still happening, despite sweeping layoffs at Halo Studios?
body: "We are eliminating 268 roles across Halo Studios, other first-party studios, and the XGS management and central functions layer," Xbox Studios chief Matt Booty wrote in a statement this week as part of the console maker's wide-ranging restructure. "Activision will also be developing the next Halo title, led by a new, purpose-built team that is separate from ongoing development and plans for Call of Duty. A small team at Halo Studios will continue supporting the Halo community and games in-market."

Xbox's restructuring laid off 1,600 workers this summer, with a further 1,600 job cuts planned over the course of the year, but it also rejigged several studios. Obsidian is now part of Bethesda, for example, and Halo is now part of Activision, along with Rare and World's Edge.

It's a dramatic shift for a franchise that was once Xbox's golden goose, and fans are conflicted about what it means for the future of the iconic sci-fi shooter series. One big worry is Activision may reboot the story and throw away lore that's been built up across 25 years - or, perhaps, scrap some of the extended universe lore, as Disney did to Star Wars when it took over that galaxy.

articles.title: Obsidian's "creative identity and strengths" will remain intact, promises Bethesda, as it takes control of Fallout: New Vegas studio
articles.summary: Xbox's massive and still ongoing reorganisation has pushed Obsidian Entertainment under Bethesda's umbrella. Despite the quite drastic corporate shakeup, Bethesda's president is promising folks the iconic RPG developer will hold onto its "creative identity."
body: Xbox's so-called "reset" kicked off earlier this year with the console maker laying off 1,600 workers and parting ways with five first-party developers. This week's continuation saw a further 268 roles cut across the division, and plenty of studios have moved around Microsoft's various gaming divisions as a result. Halo, Rare ( Sea of Thieves ) and World's Edge (Age of Empires) are now under Activision's control, while Obsidian Entertainment is being folded into Bethesda - all of them used to fall under the Xbox Game Studios banner.

While some fans are worried Obsidian might be downgraded to a mere support studio - it's currently developing a new Fallout game with Bethesda Game Studios, after all - Bethesda president Jill Braff told employees there's not much to worry about.
points: Xbox's massive and still ongoing reorganisation has pushed Obsidian Entertainment under Bethesda's umbrella.
Despite the quite drastic corporate shakeup, Bethesda's president is promising folks the iconic RPG developer will hold onto its "creative identity."

videos.summary: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan dive deep into the latest happenings at Microsoft. This week the company announced another round of layoffs and a significant reshuffling of their remaining studios, which has resulted in Activision getting their shot at Halo…
points: This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan dive deep into the latest happenings at Microsoft.
Would Activision's Halo be more Call of Duty than Halo?
What does this mean for Bungie, who has just announced a return of sorts to Destiny 2?
And what will become of Rare, who is also moving into Activision's stable of developers?
videos.author: IGN

videos.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – Tokyo Game Show Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Pre-order and play the free demo for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE now on Nintendo Switch 2:
body: Take a first look at content and features included in the first HD 2D FINAL FANTASY!

The pixel-art world of FINAL FANTASY returns in this reimagined adventure! The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon. Try out the first chapter in the free demo!
Visit Nintendo.com for more info:
